title: Content Creator
company: Greenfield I T Recruitment - Agency - Permanent
description:
Content Creator - Social & Video
York
Hybrid (2 days per week in the office)
£30,000 - £35,000 per annum plus company benefits

Are you passionate about social media, video production and digital storytelling? We're recruiting on behalf of our client for a creative Content Creator to join their marketing team and help produce engaging content across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook and other digital channels.

The Role:
- Create engaging short-form video content for social media.
- Take content from concept to filming, editing and final delivery.
- Produce social graphics, digital assets and campaign content.
- Film, edit and repurpose video content across multiple platforms.
- Support wider marketing campaigns with creative content.
- Monitor trends and develop fresh content ideas that drive engagement.
- Assist with longer-form video projects, interviews and promotional content.

The Candidate:
- 1-3 years' experience in content creation, social media, video production or a similar role.
- Strong portfolio showcasing video and social content.
- Skilled in Canva, CapCut and Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Premiere Pro, Photoshop and Illustrator.
- Strong filming, editing and storytelling abilities.
- Good understanding of social media trends and platform-specific content.
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects.
- Creative, proactive and confident working independently or as part of a team.
- Comfortable appearing on camera when required.

For further information please contact Paige Bevan on or email

title: Marketing Assistant
description:
Marketing Assistant

Offering £26,000 - £28,000 Basic Salary plus Great Benefits

Harrogate

Our client is an established manufacturing business based in Harrogate. Now recruiting a Marketing Assistant to join their friendly and established marketing team. The successful candidate will provide hands-on support across digital marketing, graphic design and artwork coordination, website and CMS updates, email marketing, social media, events, webinars, product launches, reporting and marketing administration.

Marketing Assistant - Key Responsibilities
- Work closely with the Graphic Designer to support artwork requests, design amendments and the coordination of marketing materials.
- Provide graphic design and artwork support, helping manage and complete artwork requests and amendments. Complete artwork tasks such as flyers, business cards, certificates, CPD materials, minor product collateral amends, sales support documents and sector-specific templates. Assisting the Graphic Designer Lead on larger creative projects, such as product launches, packaging and new marketing materials.
- Support the digital marketing team to maintain creative and digital outputs, supporting social media content creation, scheduling, monitoring, reporting and recommendations for improved content performance.
- Support product launches and go-to-market activity, including digital marketing, sales team communications, lead generation, print, press, awareness activity and third-party supplier coordination.
- Take ownership of marketing actions for new starters and leavers within sales teams, including business cards, promotional items, photography, website updates, territory artwork, CRM and website lead allocation, communications groups and social media welcome content.
- Support PPC and paid digital activity by working with external suppliers and preparing campaign assets for awareness, performance and PMax activity.
- Manage the marketing inbox daily, responding to queries, completing actions, escalating where required and tracking next steps.
- Collate marketing performance data for the department, including website, social media, email and YouTube reporting.

Marketing Assistant - Candidate
- Detail orientated with strong Adobe InDesign skills.
- Graphic design experience is essential.
- Knowledge, experience or a genuine interest in digital marketing would be advantageous.
- Highly organised with strong time-management skills, excellent attention to detail, and a proactive attitude towards learning and developing new skills.
- Be team orientated, with the ability to work independently.

The Marketing Assistant position is offering £26,000 - £28,000 basic salary plus great benefits for the successful candidate! This is a full-time, permanent, site-based position in Harrogate.

All successful candidates will be contacted within 5 days of application for the position of Marketing Assistant. This vacancy is being advertised by Technical Prospects Ltd. The services advertised by Technical Prospects Ltd are those of an Employment Agency.

title: Marketing Manager (Fundraising Appeals and Propositions)
company: North Yorkshire Hospice Care - Agency - Permanent
description:
Marketing Manager (Fundraising Appeals and Propositions)
Permanent Contract
Location: Hybrid, Crimple House, Hornbeam Park Avenue, Harrogate, HG2 8 NA
Hours: 37.5 hours
Salary: £36,564.58 per annum
Closing date: 31st October 2026 (the advert may close early if we receive a sufficient number of suitable applications)
Brand: Herriot Hospice Homecare, Just 'B' and Saint Michael's

Do you want to be part of an organisation that makes a real difference to our local communities? Our family of services including Herriot Hospice Homecare, Just 'B' and Saint Michael's Hospice provide vital support to people when they need it most. Our vision is of a community where everyone gets the care they need, want and deserve You can help make that a reality.

We are an independent charity powered by local communities. Every day, we help to improve quality of life for people living with terminal illness, bereavement and mental health concerns, because our belief is that no one should suffer. Our incredible teams work together to make this happen.

About the role
As Fundraising Marketing Manager (Appeals and Propositions), you will play a key role in helping North Yorkshire Hospice Care grow its fundraising income and ensure more people receive the support they need. You will develop inspiring fundraising propositions and lead creative, integrated campaigns that engage supporters, attract new audiences and demonstrate the difference donations make across Saint Michael's Hospice, Herriot Hospice and Just 'B. Working collaboratively with colleagues across fundraising, marketing, digital and clinical services, you will use insight, creativity and data to maximise campaign impact, strengthen supporter relationships and deliver sustainable income growth. This is an exciting opportunity to bring fresh ideas to our fundraising marketing and help secure the future of our vital services for local people and families.

About You
We are looking for a creative, proactive and results-driven marketing professional with proven experience in developing and delivering successful, integrated marketing or fundraising campaigns. You will have excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to create compelling, donor-focused content that inspires people to support our cause. You will be confident using audience insight and campaign data to measure performance, improve results and maximise fundraising income, alongside managing budgets, deadlines and multiple projects. With strong organisational and relationship-building skills, you will enjoy working collaboratively with colleagues, external agencies and partners to bring ideas to life. You will also demonstrate initiative, a commitment to continuous professional development and a compassionate, sensitive approach to communicating about hospice care, bereavement and emotional wellbeing, ensuring all activity reflects our values and the difference we make to local communities.

How we look after you
- We put people first in all that we do, which includes our own team
- Wellbeing and resilience support with a dedicated team by your side
- Flexible and hybrid working for many roles
- A supportive and caring environment
- Opportunities to grow, develop and progress, with culture of lifelong learning
- Benefits include 9% employer pension contribution, enhanced family leave and pay, generous annual leave, staff discount on our online shop, shopping and lifestyle discounts platform.

How to apply:
- Please click Apply and you will be forwarded to the vacancy page on our website. Click on the role and this will open the application form.
- Download and read through job description (via the 'Downloads' section at the top of the advert) as you will need to tell us how you meet the essential requirements of the role.
- Make sure you answer all supplementary questions as part of your application otherwise your application will be automatically rejected.
- We recommend reading the application pack "Joining Herriot Hospice Homecare, Just 'B' and Saint Michael's" and browsing the "Join our team" pages of our website, which will provide lots of useful information about what it's like working for us and how the recruitment process works.
- Did you hear about this role from a current employee as part of our recommend a friend scheme? Don't forget to let us know after clicking apply.

Our values
- We put the people who use our services at the heart of everything we do
- We are caring and compassionate
- We are personal and supportive in our approach
- We engage positively
- We are responsive
- We are driven to do better
- We are fair
- We are professional
- We work collaboratively
- We are accountable

Living out our values
- Our behaviour framework puts our values in the context of our everyday work.
- We positively encourage applications from all areas of the community, regardless of gender, race, faith, disability, age, or sexual orientation. As part of our commitment to equality, diversity and inclusion, we collect and monitor EDI data of applicants to help us ensure that our policies and procedures are effective in promoting equality. The information you provide in the Equality, Diversity, and Inclusion section of the application form will have no bearing on your application, it is only used for diversity monitoring and is not visible to hiring managers.
- We believe that children, young people and adults should never experience abuse of any kind. Our safer recruitment and safeguarding processes help protect those accessing our services. Please see our safeguarding statement on our website.
- If you require any support or adjustments to be able to apply for this role, please let us know by emailing
- We will need to complete satisfactory pre-employment checks before appointing you. These include but are not limited to identity checks, DBS clearance at an appropriate level for the role, verification of right to work in the UK, employment references and employment history. We will cover the cost of these.

PLEASE NOTE: Unfortunately, we are not currently able to consider applicants who require sponsorship to work in the UK.

title: Marketing Partnership Executive
description:
A leading UK menswear eCommerce retailer is hiring a Marketing Partnership Executive to join their in-house Campaigns team. This is a partner-facing role focused on managing brand marketing relationships, planning seasonal campaigns, and improving performance through data-led decision making.

You'll work closely with external brand marketing teams and internal stakeholders (Campaigns, Creative and Accounts) - negotiating contributions, keeping partner records accurate, and ensuring campaign activity is delivered smoothly with clear reporting and post-campaign feedback.

Role: Marketing Partnership Executive
Location: Outskirts of Scarborough (office-based, near A64 / Seamer train station)
Type: Permanent, full-time (9:00am-5:30pm, Monday-Friday)
Salary: Competitive - dependent on experience and skill set

Key responsibilities
- Plan and execute brand campaigns across seasonal and mid-season activity
- Review and refine marketing media packs, making amendments where needed
- Negotiate brand and third-party contributions based on buying increases and previous campaigns
- Track confirmations and maintain accurate records of brand contributions and exposure
- Analyse past campaign performance with partners and plan upcoming activity
- Liaise with Accounts to invoice partners for marketing contributions and support with queries
- Help chase outstanding payments and ensure partner commitments are delivered
- Coordinate with Creative to collect seasonal imagery and produce banners and campaign assets
- Produce review packs for paid brand activity, including performance statistics and feedback
- Proactively reach out to new brands and identify the correct marketing point of contact
- Keep the partner CRM updated with contact changes and key partner information
- Manage channel-specific conversations and requests with partner marketing teams

Key skills and experience
- Strong communication and negotiation skills, with confidence building external relationships
- Highly organised with excellent attention to detail (comfortable managing multiple priorities)
- Proactive and able to work on your own initiative in a fast-moving environment
- Positive, energetic approach - reacts quickly and constructively to changing situations
- Interest in fashion and awareness of marketing trends (fashion industry knowledge beneficial)
- Degree or relevant qualification preferred, but not essential
